correctness.rationale: For fixed n>=4, the near-antipodal events E_ij have cap probability p=(1-cos(delta))/2. Integrating leaves proves all forest intersections exactly p^e; for small delta an odd cycle is forbidden. Every rank-three nonforest surviving beyond three edges is exactly a 4-cycle, giving 3 binom(n,4) possible labelled cycles. Local tangent coordinates for the 4-cycle have four unit-disk constraints; Fubini yields 2 pi integral_0^2 r a(r)^2 dr = pi^3 - 16 pi/3, with a(r) the intersection area of two unit disks. A bounded-support Jacobian argument provides L1 / total-variation convergence of the conditional marked six-dimensional law, not merely weak convergence. Division by p^3 yields 1-16/(3 pi^2), and inclusion-exclusion yields the displayed cubic coefficient. Independent direct quadrature calculated volume 14.251115861154254 and coefficient 0.45962035390753186, with n=4 coefficient 13+16/pi^2. The numeric test is a check of the derived integral, not a proof of the limit.
